# Hero Memory base-stat value by level & rarity

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Skills affected:** Hero Memories
- **Mechanic tags:** hero-memory, base-stat, level-scaling
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-09 by MinMaxedARPG (community, hand-captured in-game)

## Setup

MinMaxedARPG hand-captured the base-stat value of each Hero Memory base affix at levels 1/10/20/30/40/50 across all five rarities, last season; the values are believed unchanged since. Credit: MinMaxedARPG.

## Raw data points

Per stat (per source Origin/Discipline/Progress) and per rarity, the base value at level 1 and every 10th level up to the rarity cap (normal 10 / magic 20 / rare 30 / epic 40 / ultimate 50). E.g. Origin '+Damage' ultimate: L1 44 → L50 132; Discipline '+Life' epic: L1 110 → L40 330; Progress '+Attack Speed' rare: L1 9.3 → L30 28. Full table in data/hero_memory_base_stats.json.

## Derived / confirmed formula

Within each rarity the value is LINEAR from the level-1 value to the rarity's max-level value; the 10/20/30/40 anchors lie on that line (verified: every captured point is within ~1.1% of the pure L1→cap line — the residual is anchor rounding). A consumer interpolates PIECEWISE-LINEARLY between the nearest anchors by the memory's level, so it reproduces the captured anchors exactly and the in-between levels to in-game precision.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Season-STABLE, hand-authored data stored at data/hero_memory_base_stats.json (top-level, NOT under seasons/), so the per-season data-scraper re-import never overwrites it; update only if a season actually changes these values. CORRECTION applied to the source capture: epic 'Life' L10/L20 were corrupt (L10 held the L20 value 217; L20 was garbage 59) — reconstructed from the clean 110→330 line to L10=161, L20=217 (L30=274, L40=330 already fit); re-verify epic Life in-game if precision matters. NOTE: epic 'Intelligence' L20=59 is NOT an error (epic Int is linear 30→90, L20≈59.2).
